rationale: The strongest honest structural route is to stop competing as a broad CE workspace or service-heavy handover provider and instead supply one narrow provenance connector through an existing qualified assessor or integrator. This changes the customer, trigger, payer event, offer, distribution, compounding mechanism, control point, and economics: the base product no longer bundles specialist review, channel partners own customer workflow and safety judgment, and repeat revenue comes from licences plus machine activations on one stack. It directly targets the only potentially distinct gap identified by the evidence while reducing direct-sales and human-review load. The redesign remains conditional because the evidence does not establish an uncovered incumbent gap, partner willingness, buyer budget, secure access, reusable implementation, or repeat activation volume.
